Man Returns Home After Funeral; Identity of Canal Body Questioned

A man from Ghaziabad, presumed dead and cremated, returned home the day after his 'terahvi' (13th-day funeral ritual). This unexpected return has raised questions about the identity of the body found in a canal, which was previously identified as his. Police are reportedly puzzled by the mysterious case.
